ArchitectureNotes.objective: Спроектировать модульную Android-архитектуру (Clean Architecture: data / domain / presentation) для альтернативного клиента Yi-камер. Каждый модуль должен иметь чёткий contract, measurable verification, и observable log markers.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Не создавать server-side компонент; не делать iOS/桌面 версию; не поддерживать камеры не-Yi.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: Yi Cloud API может измениться без предупреждения — весь API-интерфейс инкапсулирован в M-HTTP с version-fallback layer.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: Видеопоток зашифрован AES-128 — ключи получаются через облачный handshake. M-STREAM-DECODE — самый рискованный модуль.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: Local RTSP discovery не работает из-за firewall NAT — требуется fallback к cloud relay.

contract.purpose: Central application configuration: feature flags, API base URLs, build variants, and runtime settings.

export-getApiBaseUrl.PURPOSE: Return base URL for Yi Cloud API

export-isLocalRtspEnabled.PURPOSE: Check if local RTSP is allowed by config

export-YiRegion.PURPOSE: Yi Cloud region enum with per-region gateway hosts

export-RegionSelector.PURPOSE: Pick and persist the account region; feeds the base URL of M-HTTP

export-setManualBaseUrl.PURPOSE: Server typed by the user; disables every automatic region change

notes.note-1: Config values loaded from BuildConfig + default overrides. No network calls.
notes.note-2: Plan 01-08: default base URL is the US gateway (region order US, EU, SG); the fourth server api.xiaoyi.com is reachable only as a manual server.
notes.note-3: RegionSelector (currentRegion, selectRegion, currentBaseUrl, restoreBaseUrl) is implemented by ConfigModule and bound in Hilt (bindRegionSelector). Only the M-AUTH login loop calls selectRegion; the camera registry never switches region. While a manual server is set, currentRegion() is null and selectRegion/restoreBaseUrl do nothing. Log: [Config][region][BLOCK_SELECT_REGION] region=NAME (no URL).

contract.purpose: Shared HTTP client (OkHttp + Retrofit2) with TLS config, interceptors (auth header, logging), error mapping, and retry policy.

export-YiRequestSigner.PURPOSE: Single HMAC-SHA1 signer over the canonical query string (seq, userid, then caller-ordered extra params); used by device list, events and tnp device_info

export-LogRedactor.PURPOSE: maskQuery (secret-key query values) and maskJsonBody (shape-only allowlist JSON body masking) for every HTTP log line

export-YiAppHeaders.PURPOSE: Official Yi Home 6.9.8 header set on device/deviceshare/tnp requests (never on /v4/users login)

export-probeClient.PURPOSE: Client without auth interceptor, Authenticator.NONE and no redirects, for M-DEBUG-PROBE

notes.note-1: Auth header injected by AccessTokenInterceptor reading from M-AUTH token store.
notes.note-2: HTTP logger runs at BASIC level (no header values); query strings pass LogRedactor.maskQuery and bodies pass LogRedactor.maskJsonBody (only `code`, booleans and null survive; non-JSON logs as non-json len=N).
notes.note-3: Retrofit built on placeholder https://yi-api.invalid/; base URL resolved per request from M-CONFIG (BLOCK_RESOLVE_BASE_URL), so a region switch needs no rebuild.
notes.note-4: Phase 01 (plans 01-01, 01-04, 01-05): LogRedactor, YiRequestSigner, YiAppHeaders, per-request base URL, probeClient; token refresh bounded to one auth_token call per session expiry (M-AUTH).

contract.purpose: Room-based local persistence for event cache, config state, and offline playback manifest. Acts as a cache layer — source of truth is cloud, but DB ensures UI responsiveness.

export-cameraDao.PURPOSE: Camera cache table, schema v2: cameras row + transport, shared; no secret column

export-replaceAll.PURPOSE: CameraDao.replaceAll: delete + inserts in one Room transaction (used by the M-CAMERA-LIST refresh)

notes.note-1: BLOCK_DB_WRITE logs no identifiers (SEC-01): only online= and hasModel= flags, never the device serial (plan 01-02).
notes.note-2: Plan 01-12: schema version 2 (cameras row + transport, shared) with fallbackToDestructiveMigration, so the cache is wiped once on upgrade. P2P secrets never reach Room (SEC-04): YiDatabaseTest pins the exact cameras column set via PRAGMA table_info.

contract.purpose: Handle Yi Cloud authentication: login with email/password or phone, token refresh, session management, and secure storage of tokens in Android Keystore.

export-login.PURPOSE: Authenticate with Yi Cloud and store tokens

export-refreshToken.PURPOSE: Refresh access token using refresh token

export-isLoggedIn.PURPOSE: Check if user has valid session

export-getAuthMethod.PURPOSE: Return the auth method used for current session

export-DeviceListCheckPort.PURPOSE: Login region discovery check: one signed GET /v5/devices/list reduced to code + count (HttpDeviceListCheck in auth/RegionDiscovery.kt)

export-LogoutCleanup.PURPOSE: Port run synchronously by logout(): wipe camera cache + P2P credential store (implemented by CameraRegistry, injected through a Provider)

observability.critical-block: BLOCK_VALIDATE_CREDENTIALS, BLOCK_REGION_FALLBACK, BLOCK_REGION_DISCOVERY, BLOCK_REGION_SELECTED, BLOCK_STORE_TOKEN, BLOCK_REFRESH_TOKEN, BLOCK_REFRESH_ONCE_PER_EXPIRY, BLOCK_LOGOUT_CLEANUP

notes.note-1: Tokens stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences backed by Android Keystore.
notes.note-2: Token refresh happens automatically before API calls via Retrofit interceptor.
notes.note-3: Reverse-engineered auth endpoint: GET /v4/users/login (query params: seq, account, password, dev_name, dev_type, dev_os_version). Refresh: POST /v4/users/auth_token. Response code is a String; missing access_token -> InvalidCredentials.
notes.note-4: Plan 01-08 (CAM-02): explicit login hops on code 20253 and then discovers the region by device list (DeviceListCheckPort: GET /v5/devices/list, code + count). Bound per login call: 3 logins + 3 list checks, no retries; never on refresh or app start; a manual server disables both.
notes.note-5: Region rule as built (addendum): keep the first region whose /v5/devices/list answers code 20000 with count > 0; if none, keep the first region where login succeeded. A wrong password stops the loop; a network error keeps the last good session. loginMutex serialises presses; token refresh is suppressed while the check runs. This login discovery is the only place the region is chosen: the camera registry has no region fallback (tokens are per region).
notes.note-6: SEC-04 (plan 01-09 review fix): logout() is fail-closed. It clears the session, then calls LogoutCleanup synchronously; log [Auth][logout][BLOCK_LOGOUT_CLEANUP] cleared=true, or code=LOGOUT_CLEANUP_FAILED type=NAME.

contract.purpose: Fetch and cache the list of user-attached Yi cameras from cloud API. Provides live list with device status (online/offline), model info, firmware version, and stream URL resolution.

export-getCameraList.PURPOSE: Fetch camera list from cloud; empty list = no cameras

export-cachedCameras.PURPOSE: Room-only list for offline display; never throws

export-getCredentials.PURPOSE: P2P credentials of one camera from the encrypted store (Phase 2 entry point)

export-clearSignedOutData.PURPOSE: LogoutCleanup: synchronous wipe of camera cache + P2P credential store, run by AuthRepository.logout

export-purgeIfSignedOut.PURPOSE: Start-up wipe of camera cache + P2P credential store when there is no session

export-getCameraById.PURPOSE: Get single camera info by deviceId

export-getLiveStreamUrl.PURPOSE: Resolve live stream URL (cloud or local) for a camera

export-cacheCameraList.PURPOSE: Persist camera list to local DB for offline access

notes.note-1: Signed GET (hmac via M-HTTP YiRequestSigner). BRANCH A (01-PROBE-RESULTS.md + addendum): only /v5/devices/list; shared cameras are rows of the same list; the deviceshare shareddetail path is a PUT and is never called. Region = the one kept by login discovery (M-AUTH); the registry never switches region (tokens are per region). Per refresh: 1 list GET + at most 1 /v4/tnp/device_info per TNP camera without a stored license for the same DID.
notes.note-2: Live stream URL format depends on camera model — need per-model resolver.
notes.note-3: Source order as built (DeviceSourcePlan, BRANCH A): OWNED_PATHS = [/v5/devices/list]; no shared path (shared cameras are rows of the same list, category/share), no /v4 fallback (DevicePaths.LIST_V4 is a named constant only). Code 20200 or empty data = no cameras: Room and the P2P store are cleared. Outcomes: 401/20201/20202/20203 -> Unauthorized; IO, 5xx, non-JSON -> FetchFailed; any other code -> ServerRejected (CAMERA_SERVER_ERROR); errors never touch the cache or the store.
notes.note-4: No BLOCK_REGION_FALLBACK in this module (deviation from plan 01-09, per the addendum): the registry uses the region kept by M-AUTH login discovery. The logout wipe is triggered by M-AUTH (LogoutCleanup -> clearSignedOutData); purgeIfSignedOut runs from MainActivity at start without a session. Both log [Camera][clearAll][BLOCK_CLEAR_CAMERA_DATA]; there is no export named clearAll.
notes.note-5: getLiveStreamUrl stays as legacy (the cloud list carries no stream URL, so it throws NoStreamUrl after a refresh); live view goes through getCredentials in GSD Phase 2.

export-getEventById.PURPOSE: Get single event with full details

export-getPlaybackUrl.PURPOSE: Resolve playback URL for an event

contract.purpose: Establish and manage live video stream from a Yi camera. Supports cloud relay stream and (optionally) local RTSP stream. Handles stream lifecycle (connect, buffer, play, disconnect), reconnection on network change, and quality adaptation.

export-startStream.PURPOSE: Initialize and connect to camera stream

export-getLatencyMs.PURPOSE: Return current measured latency in ms

notes.note-1: Cloud stream URL: /v1/camera/live/stream — returns encrypted media URL with session key.
notes.note-2: Local RTSP: rtsp://<camera_ip>/live — only works on same LAN, uses standard RTSP.
notes.note-3: Stream uses ExoPlayer with custom DataSource for encrypted HLS/HTTP stream.

contract.purpose: Handle video stream decryption and decoding. Decrypts AES-128 encrypted Yi camera streams using keys from the cloud handshake. Wraps ExoPlayer MediaSource with decryption support.

export-createDecryptedSource.PURPOSE: Create ExoPlayer MediaSource from encrypted URL + AES key

export-handshakeWithCamera.PURPOSE: Perform handshake to obtain AES session key

export-validateKey.PURPOSE: Verify AES key is valid before creating source

notes.note-1: Yi streams use AES-128-ECB or AES-128-CBC. Key derived from cloud handshake response.
notes.note-2: Handshake endpoint: POST /v1/camera/live/key (reverse-engineered — returns session key).
notes.note-3: This is the most reverse-engineering-heavy module. API surface may change.

contract.purpose: Playback of recorded event clips. Resolves playback URL (cloud CDN or local), manages download buffer, and delegates to ExoPlayer for video rendering.

export-seekTo.PURPOSE: Seek to position (ms) in the event clip

export-showLocalNotification.PURPOSE: Show Android notification for event alert

export-deepLinkFromPush.PURPOSE: Navigate to event playback from push deep-link

notes.note-1: Push payload contains: eventType (motion), deviceId, eventId, timestamp, thumbnailUrl.
notes.note-2: Yi Cloud sends push via Firebase (FCM) — need to register FCM token with Yi Cloud API.

fn-analyze.PURPOSE: Reduce a response to status, code, length, item count and field names

notes.note-1: Debug builds only. Never logs values: no tokens, serials, uids, passwords, URLs with query strings.
notes.note-2: Request bound per press: at most 13 GET (12 list + at most 1 tnp device_info), 0 POST, 0 auth_token. Runs on HttpClientModule.probeClient() (no auth interceptor, Authenticator.NONE). Expired session = zero requests. Replaces the deleted DeviceSignProbe.

contract.purpose: Per-camera P2P transport and credentials: transport resolution, camera-password recovery, tnp device info, encrypted persistence (never Room)

error.NOTE: logged warning (count only) when the encrypted commit returns false; no exception

contract.error-policy: No exceptions: an unknown transport is TransportType.UNKNOWN, a password that cannot be recovered is null, a missing tnp device info is null.

export-TransportResolver.PURPOSE: resolve(type, p2pId): 2 -> TNP, 0 -> TUTK, 1 -> LANGTAO, other -> UNKNOWN; a missing type falls back to the TNP DID shape; a type/shape conflict sets mismatch, type wins

export-CameraPasswordCipher.PURPOSE: decrypt(passwordHex, cloudUid): AES/ECB/PKCS5 with key = first 16 chars of the cloud uid; blank field -> factory default; any failure -> null, never logs

export-P2pCredentialStore.PURPOSE: get / replaceAll / clear; EncryptedP2pCredentialStore (EncryptedSharedPreferences file yicamalt_p2p, bound in Hilt) and InMemoryP2pCredentialStore; never Room

type-P2pCredentials.PURPOSE: Per-camera transport, p2p id, password, InitString, license, needsPincode; toString prints flags only

type-TransportType.PURPOSE: TNP | TUTK | LANGTAO | UNKNOWN (fromStorage maps unknown names to UNKNOWN)

notes.note-1: Secret values (passwords, uids) are never logged; tests assert redaction.
notes.note-2: Secrets live in memory / EncryptedSharedPreferences only (SEC-04); the Room cameras row holds transport and shared, nothing else.
notes.note-3: BLOCK_RESOLVE_TRANSPORT and BLOCK_DECRYPT_CAMERA_PASSWORD are code anchors in pure helpers that never log. The only log line of this module is [P2pCreds][replaceAll][BLOCK_STORE_P2P_CREDENTIALS] count=N (or code=P2P_STORE_FAILED count=N). The signed GET /v4/tnp/device_info is issued by M-CAMERA-LIST (BLOCK_RESOLVE_P2P_CREDENTIALS) through YiCloudDeviceApi.tnpDeviceInfo; this module only types and stores the result.
notes.note-4: EncryptedP2pCredentialStore needs the Android Keystore and is covered on the device only (plan 01-11 Task 2/3).

DF-AUTH.NAME: UserAuthentication
DF-AUTH.step-2: M-AUTH validates credentials via M-HTTP (GET /v4/users/login), hops on 20253 and keeps the first region whose GET /v5/devices/list is non-empty (max 3 + 3 requests)
DF-AUTH.step-3: M-AUTH stores tokens in encrypted SharedPreferences
DF-AUTH.step-4: AuthState updates to LOGGED_IN, navigation shifts to AppShell

DF-CAMERA-LIST.NAME: CameraListFetch
DF-CAMERA-LIST.TRIGGER: App launches or camera list refreshed
DF-CAMERA-LIST.step-2: M-CAMERA-LIST calls M-HTTP: one signed GET /v5/devices/list (seq, userid, hmac) on the region kept by login, plus at most one signed GET /v4/tnp/device_info per TNP camera without a stored license for the same DID
DF-CAMERA-LIST.step-3: M-CAMERA-LIST parses rows (DeviceRecordParser), stores P2P credentials in M-P2P-CREDS (encrypted), replaces the M-LOCAL-DB cache in one transaction

DF-LIVE-STREAM.NAME: LiveViewConnection

DF-LIVE-STREAM.step-4: M-STREAM-DECODE creates decrypted MediaSource for ExoPlayer
DF-LIVE-STREAM.step-5: ExoPlayer initializes, video renders on surface
DF-LIVE-STREAM.step-6: Stream state reported back to UI (playing / error / reconnecting)

DF-EVENT-LIST.NAME: EventTimelineLoad
DF-EVENT-LIST.step-2: M-EVENT fetches from cloud (GET /v1/camera/event/list) via M-HTTP
DF-EVENT-LIST.step-4: M-EVENT returns paginated events with thumbnails

DF-PLAYBACK.NAME: EventClipPlayback
DF-PLAYBACK.step-2: M-EVENT-PLAYBACK resolves playback URL via M-EVENT.getPlaybackUrl()
DF-PLAYBACK.step-4: Video plays on surface with controls

DF-CMD-PTZ.NAME: PTZControl
DF-CMD-PTZ.step-1: M-UI-LIVEVIEW converts joystick delta to PTZ angles

DF-PUSH-NOTIF.NAME: PushNotificationDelivery
DF-PUSH-NOTIF.TRIGGER: Cloud sends push for motion event
DF-PUSH-NOTIF.step-2: M-PUSH parses payload, shows local notification
DF-PUSH-NOTIF.step-3: User taps notification → deep link to event playback
DF-PUSH-NOTIF.step-4: M-PUSH navigates to M-UI-EVENTPLAYBACK with eventId

DF-CMD-CONFIG.step-3: Camera acknowledges, M-CAMERA-LIST updates device name

ExecutionPolicy.worker-owns: Only module source files and module-local tests inside the approved write scope.
ExecutionPolicy.replanning-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory contract, unclear third-party surface (Yi API changes), or native build failure that persists after 2 attempts.
ExecutionPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every step must leave assumptions, commands run, evidence, and next action.
